query_ledger.query: Which 2025-2026 U.S. EV model and trim configurations have the highest verified EPA efficiency and useful range? United States Model years 2025-2026; ownership horizons of 5 and 10 years from purchase. Compare currently available U.S. battery-electric vehicle models and trims for model years 2025-2026. Assess EPA efficiency, range, price/incentives, charging costs, maintenance, reliability concerns, recalls, warranty, and 5- and 10-year ownership costs. Use a clearly declared 12,000-mile annual driving baseline and show electricity-price, home/public charging mix, insurance, depreciation, incentive, and ownership-duration sensitivities; leave geography-dependent inputs unknown unless a location is supplied. excluding Do not infer that the most efficient model is the lowest-cost or best vehicle for every driver.; Do not treat search snippets, manufacturer claims, or historical recalls as independently verified current model-year evidence.; Do not estimate a single total cost without stating acquisition, energy, maintenance, depreciation, insurance, tax, incentive, and charging assumptions.
